questionProposals.assessedUnderstanding: Choose the shared-responsibility matrix/model as the offered resource for allocating customer/provider duties by cloud service layer, subject to service terms.
questionProposals.contentQualification: HOLD a responsibility matrix/model as one universal contract, proof of executed security work or a legal liability determination. Service model, selected features and agreement allocate duties; an SOW or SLA can contain the same allocation, so these documents are not mutually exclusive with a matrix. Risk appetite concerns acceptance, not itself a layer-duty map; a penalty clause is not a complete allocation. One compound matrix/model label is one resource-purpose decision, not two independent skills. Authored generic repeated-key wrong feedback is superseded by explicit purpose contrasts; imported QB1 provenance is an input label, not certification. Correlate with m017/m148/m620/m060; no provider, agreement, migration, patch, compliance or duty fulfilment is observed.

Cloud-service discovery depends on data sources, while offered network/request inspection has other scope. Preserve m261 stipulated decoding/inspection limits and cloud-control numbered scope hold without new products or observed traffic.

Layer/tier pattern recognition, IaC definition and VLAN naming do not independently establish implemented boundaries, scan enforcement or restricted paths. m305WholeScopeHold.contentQualification: HOLD precise whole-item 2.3 assessment scope: the offered decision chooses a mitigation, whereas 2.3 is vulnerability explanation. Retain 2.3 misconfiguration context; do not force a second numbered objective. No actual cache poisoning attacker input, HTTP header policy, cross-user isolation test, purge, reconfiguration or recovery is performed. Shared-cache privacy differs from transport encryption; no universal claim about all authenticated caching follows.

objective23FeedbackHolds.contentQualification: HOLD reflected and DOM-based XSS as universally exclusive categories, all stored XSS as server-only or every visitor exposure, HttpOnly/CSP as universal XSS prevention, and every XSS as cookie theft. The supplied immediate response path supports the offered reflected pattern; client/server and stored/reflected dimensions can overlap. Cookie access is a fictional outcome, not measured browser entitlement or security. Do not approve a precise mutually-exclusive DOM-versus-reflected contrast from the wrong feedback.

HOLD predictable/sequential IDs as required for IDOR, ownership as the only valid authorisation policy, login as object permission, or mass assignment as necessarily binding all submitted fields. Missing object/action authorisation supports the decision; random IDs alone do not repair it. The retained all-parameters mass-assignment correction is overbroad and precise contrast is held. SSRF/CSRF/property-binding can coexist with permission failures; no defense is implemented.

HOLD a symlink alone as TOCTOU, an uncoordinated lock/file descriptor as universal prevention, or directory traversal as requiring literal dot-dot-slash. The described check-use gap supports the offered TOCTOU decision, but the retained directory-traversal wrong correction is too narrow; preserve its precise-contrast hold. Repeating or shortening separate checks does not eliminate the race. Correlate with m248; do not infer this subtype from every m612 shared-state race.

HOLD sequential numbers as necessary for IDOR, object enumeration alone as proof of missing checks absent the supplied unauthorised access, and the tester as necessarily authenticated. Current wrong feedback asserts authentication that the effective stem does not state; retain that exact premise hold. IDOR/object authorisation still explains access to records belonging to other users. No login-session, SSRF or implemented permission-check outcome is supplied; correlate with m052 and prior operation-permission m271.

objective24HeldDispositions.contentQualification: HOLD whole numbered 2.4 assessment scope: the keyed decision selects a mitigation rather than analyzes an indicator. Retain replay context without forcing another numbered objective. Fresh challenges require binding, validation and reuse/expiry enforcement; merely adding a nonce, timestamp, signature, password-at-rest protection or shorter session lifetime does not universally prevent reuse. One combined choice supplies no independently keyed freshness components. Old attack/mitigation pair and metadata-only DNSSEC/MITM references do not establish those skills or tooltip delivery; no verifier or replay defense executes.

HOLD spoofed sources as unique attacker/host counts, UDP/open recursion alone as sufficient amplification without size asymmetry, all DNS as UDP, all TCP amplification as impossible, or authoritative DNS as never an amplifier. The supplied small-query/large-reply path supports reflection plus amplification in one combined choice, not three trusted components. DNSSEC authenticates data rather than stopping reflected traffic; no universal factor, crash, botnet or implemented anti-spoofing is established. Correlate with m259 and retain prior DDoS glossary/actor holds.

HOLD forged replies alone as cached poisoning absent the supplied cache acceptance, DNSSEC as encrypted queries or universal safety/availability, DNS amplification as necessarily targeting the resolver itself, or BGP hijacking as confined to backbone routers. Current caching evidence corrects the authored interception-only ambiguity. The retained amplification option shorthand and backbone-level wrong correction need precise qualifications; keep their contrast hold without rewriting learner content. ARP/BGP/DNS mechanisms may coexist. No signed answer, route or effective resolver defense is validated.

HOLD whole numbered 2.4 scope: this choice identifies persistence purpose rather than a specific malicious indicator; retain malicious-code context with exact alignment pending. Scheduled tasks also support legitimate work and multiple adversary goals; here post-compromise malicious relaunch is explicit. Persistence is not proof of an APT actor, long dwell, initial access, exfiltration or discovery. The authored ATT&CK ID/masquerading recall and unconditional Task-Scheduler-log event claim are superseded. Event4698 is conditional Security auditing, not verified execution or successful detection. No task or event log is created/read.

objective24SecondHeldDispositions.contentQualification: HOLD this process chain or encoded command as proof of a macro, spear-phishing attachment, named/role-targeted victim, malicious intent, LSASS dumping, pass-the-hash or registry persistence. The supplied parent-child relationship supports a first hypothesis only; legitimate automation and other document-trigger paths require investigation. Base64 is encoding rather than proof of encryption. Authored ATT&CK ID nesting and Event4688 provenance/command-line/targeting assumptions are superseded. No content is decoded/executed, provenance verified, event audited or learner investigation observed. Preserve m046 named-individual, actor and m258 persistence holds.

HOLD a cloned destination alone as registrar hijacking, every takeover as requiring the same account-theft path, or domain hijacking as the same as resolver-cache poisoning, typo registration or on-path positioning. Here registrar access and settings alteration are explicit. The current typosquatting correction uses broad look-alike shorthand: resemblance alone does not establish deliberate mistyping, and Unicode/homograph ambiguity remains held. Preserve m015 typo hold and m050/m706 DNS qualifications. Imported domain1/generic feedback is superseded; no real registrar, records, registration or defenses are checked.

HOLD changing or statistically unusual names, fixed timing, same IP range or outbound DNS alone as a confirmed DGA, C2, malware executable, file hash, inbound connection or actor identity. Current category choice and main feedback remove the authored definitive DGA-C2 inference. No process/file/registration evidence is supplied here, unlike m285 and prior m131. DNS and timing are correlated observations within one keyed decision, not two trusted components. Suspicion warrants investigation; no statistical classifier, telemetry, threat lookup or confirmed compromise is measured.

objective24FinalHeldDispositions.contentQualification: HOLD location/time anomalies as proven compromise, accurate physical geolocation, concurrently active sessions, impossible legitimate activity or successful authentication as an explicit stem result. Current main feedback qualifies VPN/geolocation false positives. Wrong feedback says both logins succeeded although the stem only says authenticating; that premise is held. Its resource-consumption contrast overemphasises cryptomining: resource anomalies have many malicious and benign causes. Lockout depends on policy, not a universal threshold; out-of-cycle logging needs an activity baseline. No real SIEM, clocks, timestamps, travel, sessions, credentials or baseline is checked. Authored domain4/likely-attacker inference is superseded; exact 2.4 indicator recognition remains pending.

HOLD every DNS response ratio as 50x, DNS traffic alone as a flood, distribution or achieved outage as stated, and poisoning/hijacking/zone-transfer as categorically unable to coexist with amplification. The stem supplies a 60-to-3000-byte example and victim-directed replies but main feedback supplies spoofing/open-resolver context; do not invent observed source spoofing, multiple attackers or reflector counts. Current wrong corrections retain absolute no-amplification/no-flood shorthand and DNS hijacking as only malicious-site redirection. Zone transfer is data copying; unauthorised disclosure is conditional. One combined answer is not separate ratio, reflection and DDoS evidence. Preserve m710/m259 correlation and m050 DNS target/BGP hold; no request or mitigation executes.

HOLD administrator access as kernel-level execution, rootkits as kernel-only, local-tool detection as universally impossible, bootable forensics as the only remedy, or concealment as incompatible with adware/worm/spyware behavior. Main feedback now says tools may be unreliable and independent analysis may help; old universal detection/removal claims are superseded. Supplied OS-call filtering supports the offered rootkit trait, closely correlated with m433. No privilege escalation, live host analysis, detection or restored trust is observed.

Correlate closely with m054, with no implemented propagation or independently approved family.

Advertising alone, consent wording or revenue motive does not establish malicious installation, legitimacy or legal classification. The stem stipulates malware; adware can track users and coexist with keylogging/extortion. No actual advertisement, consent, tracking, revenue or removal is measured.

objective25HeldDispositions.contentQualification: HOLD absence of a released patch as sufficient zero-day evidence. Newly discovered does not specify discovery-time vendor/defender unknownness; the retained keyed option still asserts zero-day while the main feedback only establishes patch unavailability. Prior m130/m613 unknown-flaw qualifications remain; do not turn lack of a fix into unknownness or failed patching.
